svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 14 (CUMULATIVE R494) · SHARED WINDOWLESS MCP HUB & SPACED-TRANSFER ONBOARDING
craft-mcp-hub (★21 Shared Engine) + guanlan v0.22.7 + teach-to-learn (★22) + Tau Scout MCP
1. AndrianLeah/craft-mcp-hub (★21 · Rust Multiplexer · MIT)
• One Shared Windowless Engine per App Across All AI Sessions
crafthub connect <app> ➔ crafthub serve <app> (127.0.0.1:7801)
Eliminates "library is already open" errors across Claude, Cursor, VS Code & Codex
2. wangkefan0309-ui/guanlan v0.22.7 (★17 · Obsidian 1.13+ · MIT)
• Aggregates WeChat Official Accounts, YouTube, Bilibili & RSS inside Obsidian
• Local Markdown/subtitle reading requires 0 account, 0 model & 0 network
• One-click Claudian Handoff sends selected article + task context to in-vault agent
• Eliminates browser tab distraction and manual copy-paste context loss
3. olele114/teach-to-learn (★22 · 2 forks · Zero-Dep Skill · MIT)
• 6-Stage Evidence-Gated Mastery & 1/3/7/14-Day Review Queue
Observable Goal ➔ <=3 Diagnostics ➔ 5-15m Lesson ➔ Open-Ended Recall (no MCQ cues)
Logs assistance levels & requires passing an Unseen Transfer Task to graduate
4. ArsenOria/tau-linkedin-job-research-mcp v0.3 (★15 · MIT)
• Local stdio MCP server for LinkedIn role search & CV evidence comparison
• BYO Apify token with explicit search cap + zero-cost demo mode
• Persists job shortlists locally for $0 iterative skill/experience/remote audits
• Requires no Tau server, no LinkedIn login, and no second LLM API key
